info.name: Foodwell Catalog and Delivery Slots
info.description: Products, categories and delivery slots (#39-#42): public reads, filters, paging, XML, staff-only writes (401/403), validation (422), conflicts (409), and attaching a slot at checkout. Run with composer test:catalog, which provides a disposable database with the synthetic demo accounts.

exec: pm.test("10 seeded products, ordered by id", () => { pm.expect(body.meta.total).to.eql(10); pm.expect(body.data.map(p => p.id)).to.eql([101,102,103,104,105,106,107,108,109,110]); });
pm.test("Dairy by price, highest first", () => pm.expect(body.data.map(p => p.id)).to.eql([102, 101]));
pm.test("Total counts all 3 matches, not just this page", () => { pm.expect(body.meta.total).to.eql(3); pm.expect(body.meta.totalPages).to.eql(2); });

pm.test("Next link keeps the filters", () => { const next = body.meta.next; pm.expect(next).to.include("page=2"); pm.expect(next).to.include("category=2"); pm.expect(next).to.include("sort=-price"); });
pm.test("The last Dairy product", () => pm.expect(body.data.map(p => p.id)).to.eql([103]));
pm.test("Last page: no next, previous goes to page 1", () => { pm.expect(body.meta.next).to.eql(null); pm.expect(body.meta.previous).to.include("page=1"); });
pm.test("Says sort was repeated", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.message).to.include("sort was given 2 times"));
pm.test("Saved as sent", () => { pm.expect(body.name).to.eql("Newman Oat Milk"); pm.expect(body.price).to.eql(3.49); pm.expect(body.categoryName).to.eql("Dairy"); pm.expect(body.stock).to.eql(5); });
pm.test("Location points at the new product", () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("Location")).to.match(new RegExp("/products/" + body.id + "$")));
pm.test("Changed and deactivated", () => { pm.expect(body.name).to.eql("Newman Oat Milk 2L"); pm.expect(body.price).to.eql(5.99); pm.expect(body.isActive).to.eql(false); });
pm.test("Stock is untouched by PUT", () => pm.expect(body.stock).to.eql(5));
pm.test("GET shows the update", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().name).to.eql("Newman Oat Milk 2L"));

exec: pm.test("Only slot 304 is bookable in the seed data", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.map(s => s.id)).to.eql([304]));
// A 2-hour window 5 days from now, in UTC, on the hour.

pm.test("Saved in UTC, empty and bookable", () => { pm.expect(body.startsAt).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("slotStart")); pm.expect(body.bookedCount).to.eql(0); pm.expect(body.availableCapacity).to.eql(2); pm.expect(body.isAvailable).to.eql(true); });
pm.test("Location points at the new slot", () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("Location")).to.match(new RegExp("/delivery-slots/" + body.id + "$")));
pm.test("Says the window exists", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.message).to.include("same startsAt and endsAt"));

item.name: Refuse a slot that ends before it starts
Check out with the new slot

exec: pm.test("The order is attached to the slot", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().deliverySlotId).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("slotId"))));

item.name: The slot now has one booking

exec: // Same start, one hour longer: the window moves.
pm.test("Says the window cannot change", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.message).to.include("cannot change"));
// Seed slot 301 has 2 bookings. Read its current window first (it is
// relative to today), so only the capacity changes: 2 -> 1.
pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.variables.get('baseUrl') + '/delivery-slots/301', method: 'GET', header: { Accept: 'application/json' } }, (err, res) => {
pm.test("Says capacity cannot be lower", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.message).to.include("cannot be lower"));
pm.test("Inactive, not bookable, booking kept", () => { pm.expect(body.isActive).to.eql(false); pm.expect(body.isAvailable).to.eql(false); pm.expect(body.bookedCount).to.eql(1); });
